title: On the Challenges of Using Black-Box APIs for Toxicity Evaluation in Research

bias_targets.methodology: Rescoring the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and HELM benchmark models using different temporal versions of the black-box Perspective API to evaluate inconsistencies, temporal drift, and reproducibility issues in toxicity evaluation.
Qualitative analysis of how Perspective API toxicity scores shifted over time for dataset prompts containing specific racial terms, such as 'black' and 'white'.
Qualitative evaluation of temporal shifts in toxicity classifications for prompts containing words related to sex and gender across different API versions.
Observing discrepancies and shifts in Perspective API toxicity scores for prompts that contain non-American words, names, and regional references.
